name: dcs_workshop
description: DCS schema constructor for reports / data processors / register macros. Pass operation=<name>; call operation=help for the catalog and operation=help topic=parameters for the full rules of the parameters. Auto-validates queryText and expressions before write. A settings write that leaves a filter comparing against nothing, or a standard period with no dates, answers with `settingsWarnings` - a warning, not a refusal. Removing a dataset, a dataset field, a parameter, a calculated field or a total field lists the settings that still reference it (`affectedSettings`) and does not clear them. DCS direct save to .dcs disk file is automatic for extension projects.

projectName.description: Name of the EDT project to work in

objectName.description: Owner FQN (Report.X / DataProcessor.X) or full schema FQN

formFqn.description: Form holding a dynamic list, e.g. Catalog.X.Form.ListForm.

attributeName.description: Dynamic-list attribute on formFqn whose settings the operation applies to

templateName.description: DCS template name. Default ОсновнаяСхемаКомпоновкиДанных, or MainDataCompositionSchema on an English configuration.

name.description: Name of the new element (parameter / field / etc.)

queryText.description: BSL query text for add_dataset (Query type) and set_dataset_query (replaces the whole query of an existing Query dataset; multi-statement / UNION OK)

expression.description: DCS expression for calculated field / total

dataPath.description: add_total: the path to the data the total runs over. Default the expression as given, not the aggregate wrapped around it.

aggregateFunction.description: Aggregate for add_total: Sum / Count / Min / Max / Avg

direction.description: Up / Down for move_parameter; Asc / Desc for add_order (alias of orderType, default Asc)

sourceDataSet.description: Source dataset name for dataset-link ops

destinationDataSet.description: Destination dataset name for dataset-link ops

parentPath.description: add_grouping: the group to nest the new one inside, as dot-separated group names ('Объект.Статья').

variantName.description: set_settings_parameter: the settings variant to work on. Omitted means the default settings, which is the first variant.

userSettingID.description: set_settings_parameter: the identifier under which the parameter appears in user settings, so BSL can set it before the report form opens.

use.description: set_settings_parameter used flag. Schema parameter: true = Always, false = Auto.

valueListAllowed.description: Schema parameter accepts a value list.

index.description: 0-based item index for remove/set settings-item ops

field.description: Field path for grouping / order / selected-field / filter ops, the field of a conditional appearance's filter (add_appearance), and the field-match branch of remove_settings_filter / remove_settings_order (alternative to index).

condition.description: Query condition expression for add_query_condition / remove_query_condition (e.g. 'T.Sum > &MinSum'). add splices it into WHERE/ГДЕ; remove drops it and the connector beside it.

appearance.description: Appearance spec 'Name=Value;Name=Value' for add_appearance / set_data_set_field_appearance. Keys: TextColor, BackColor, BorderColor, Font, Format, or their Russian equivalents.

title.description: Presentation/title for selected-field / calculated-field / parameter, and what a nested schema is called on screen (optional).

sourceName.description: Source settings-variant name to copy from (clone_settings_variant).

dryRun.description: Preview changes inside BM transaction (default false)

reportAffectedSettings.description: remove_dataset, remove_dataset_field, remove_parameter, remove_calculated_field, remove_total_field: list settings that still reference the removed element. Default true. The settings are left unchanged. false omits the list.

overwriteModel.description: repair_schema: replace a schema the model holds when it differs from the .dcs. Default false.

connectionString.description: add_data_source: connection string (for non-Local data source types).

dataSet.description: set_data_set_field_appearance: target dataset name (distinct from dataSetName).

itemPath.description: remove_settings_item: dot-separated path of the item to remove. Each step names a collection with the item in brackets, by number (Structure[0]) or by name ([Период], [Сумма]); a name matches the item's name, dataPath, field, parameter or filter left value, ignoring case.

orderType.description: add_order: Asc / Desc (default Asc; alias of direction).

url.description: add_nested_schema: where the nested schema reads its data from.

dataObjectName.description: add_dataset / add_union_item with dataSetType=Object: the object that dataset reads. Required there, refused on any other dataset type.

groupName.description: add_group_template / remove_group_template: the grouping being drawn.

groupName2.description: add_total_template / remove_total_template: the second grouping of the crossing.

templateType2.description: add_total_template: the area type of the second grouping.

header.description: add_group_template / remove_group_template: the grouping's header rather than its body. Default false.

templateType.description: add_group_template: Header / Footer / HierarchicalHeader / HierarchicalFooter / OverallHeader / OverallFooter.

rowIndex.description: add_template_cell: which row of the template body, 0-based. Default the last.

schemaTemplateName.description: The template INSIDE the schema that an operation works on.

nestedSchemaName.description: Name of a nested schema to work inside.
